notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (quì, nuzziale, legitime, deva, com uom, ordin, diavol, dell' inferno). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions joined with ‿ only where the score sets two words on one note, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced; diphthongs sung on one note (io, voi, noi, lei, mai, sue, costui) are written as one syllable. "È cresciuto a tutti il naso" (everyone's nose has grown) means they all look foolish. Translation literal, for meaning.
